description: This file implements elliptic curve operations for the NIST P-256 curve, including point addition, doubling, scalar multiplication, and conversion to affine coordinates, using field arithmetic generated by Fiat. It also includes methods for elliptic curve group operations in Jacobian coordinates, with specific functions for the P-256 curve in the BoringSSL library.

methods.name: fiat_p256_nz
methods.description: Checks if the given field element is non-zero.

methods.name: fiat_p256_copy
methods.description: Copies one field element to another.

methods.name: fiat_p256_cmovznz
methods.description: Constant-time conditional move based on zero/non-zero condition.

methods.name: fiat_p256_inv_square
methods.description: Calculates the inverse square of a field element using Fermat's Little Theorem.

methods.name: fiat_p256_point_double
methods.description: Performs point doubling in Jacobian coordinates.

methods.name: fiat_p256_point_add
methods.description: Performs point addition in Jacobian coordinates.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp256_point_get_affine_coordinates
methods.description: Converts Jacobian coordinates to affine coordinates.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp256_add
methods.description: Adds two points in Jacobian coordinates.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp256_dbl
methods.description: Doubles a point in Jacobian coordinates.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp256_point_mul
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication of a point.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp256_point_mul_base
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication of the base point.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp256_point_mul_public
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication with a public point.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp256_cmp_x_coordinate
methods.description: Compares the x-coordinate of a point with a scalar.
